researchDraft.querySummary: Past 24h signals show the AI infrastructure race is simultaneously financializing and hitting energy/regulatory ceilings: NVIDIA's record earnings and Vera Rubin production ramp, US PCE inflation repricing rate-hike risk, Anthropic's $45B compute lease with on-site gas generation, OpenAI's first superior self-designed inference chip benchmarks, Taiwan-led export-control prosecution at the logistics/packaging layer, Texas's ERCOT interconnection audit, and SoftBank's bond/margin-loan leverage build.

en.title: NVIDIA reports record revenue and confirms Vera Rubin volume production
en.coreFact: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.22B, +106% YoY; data center revenue was $89B, +117%; Q3 guide is $108B (±2%); Vera Rubin is in full production and expected to be ~20% of Q3 data center revenue; CFO sees ~70% FY2028 revenue growth; management frames opportunity as ~$400B revenue per 1GW of compute deployed.
en.whyItMatters: Confirms AI infrastructure demand is structurally accelerating, not peaking, and directly ties compute value to gigawatt-scale power. It also signals NVIDIA's shift from chip vendor to financing intermediary through the $500B third-party AI infrastructure plan.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this specific earnings-plus-production ramp; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 英伟达创纪录营收并确认Vera Rubin全面量产
zh.coreFact: 英伟达2027财年第二季度营收962.2亿美元，同比增长106%；数据中心营收890亿美元，同比增长117%；第三季度指引1080亿美元（±2%）；Vera Rubin已全面投产，预计贡献第三季度约20%数据中心营收；管理层提出“每部署1吉瓦算力对应约400亿美元营收机会”；CFO预计2028财年营收增速约70%。
zh.whyItMatters: 这证实AI基建需求处于结构性加速而非见顶，并将算力价值直接锚定在吉瓦级电力上。同时，英伟达正通过5000亿美元第三方AI基建融资计划从芯片销售商转向融资中介。
zh.processMatchReason: 本档案中无既有进程完全对应此财报与量产信号，故suggestedProcessId为空。

en.title: US July PCE at 3.7% forces market to reprice rate-hike risk
en.coreFact: July PCE rose 3.7% YoY vs 3.6% expected; core PCE was 3.3%; the federal funds rate is 3.50%-3.75%; the market now sees a slightly higher chance of a Fed hike; the 10Y Treasury yield is about 4.64%; the 2s/30s curve closed at its flattest since the July FOMC; Boston Fed's Collins supports holding rates only if inflation keeps falling.
en.whyItMatters: Higher-for-longer or a hike raises debt financing costs for AI infrastructure just as Anthropic, OpenAI, SoftBank and others are adding billions in leverage, exposing the AI boom's growing dependence on cheap capital.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this macro-financial repricing signal; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 美国7月PCE同比3.7%超预期，市场重新定价加息风险
zh.coreFact: 7月PCE同比3.7%（预期3.6%），核心PCE 3.3%；联邦基金利率处于3.50%-3.75%；市场认为美联储加息可能性略升；10年期美债收益率约4.64%；2s/30s曲线收于7月FOMC以来最平；波士顿联储柯林斯支持维持利率不变但前提是通胀持续回落。
zh.whyItMatters: 若美联储转向加息，AI基建的债务融资成本将上升。此时正值Anthropic、OpenAI、软银等大规模加杠杆，AI热潮的边际融资正日益依赖债务，资本成本可能成为新约束。
zh.processMatchReason: 本档案中无既有进程完全对应此宏观金融重定价信号，故suggestedProcessId为空。

en.title: Anthropic signs $45B, six-year compute lease with Nscale using on-site gas power
en.coreFact: Anthropic will pay Nscale $45B over six years for ~460MW at the Monarch site in West Virginia; the system begins ramping in late 2027 using Nvidia Vera Rubin; Nscale's Phase 1 plans 1.35GW with a long-term power runway of over 8GW and a target of 2GW from Caterpillar gas microgrid generation by early 2028; Nscale also has a 1.35GW LOI with Microsoft and closed $790M project financing for its Narvik, Norway data center.
en.whyItMatters: This is the largest known single AI compute lease and brings natural-gas on-site generation into hyperscale AI, shifting the energy strategy debate beyond nuclear and grid extension. It also entrenches the 'neocloud' model and a cross-Atlantic AI infrastructure structure.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this compute-lease-plus-energy signal; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: Anthropic与Nscale签下450亿美元/6年算力租赁，并采用现场天然气发电
zh.coreFact: Anthropic承诺6年支付450亿美元，租用Nscale在西弗吉尼亚Monarch园区约460MW算力，系统2027年底起上线，采用Nvidia Vera Rubin；园区一期规划1.35GW，长期电力跑道超8GW，目标2028年初达2GW Caterpillar天然气微电网发电；Nscale还与微软签有1.35GW LOI，并为挪威Narvik数据中心完成7.9亿美元项目融资。
zh.whyItMatters: 这是已知最大的单一AI计算租赁承诺，标志着天然气现场发电正式进入超大规模AI算力；“租用而非自建”的neocloud模式成为主流路径，并构成跨大西洋AI基建新结构。

en.title: OpenAI's self-designed 'Jalapeño' inference chip shows 1.5-1.9x better per-watt throughput than Nvidia systems
en.coreFact: OpenAI released first benchmark data for its 700W custom inference chip: at peak throughput, per-watt AI workload is 1.5-1.9x higher than Nvidia GB200/GB300 systems and end-to-end latency is 1.7-3.6x lower; OpenAI says 'We made a chip and it is fast.'
en.whyItMatters: If scaled, it would reduce AI inference demand for Nvidia GPUs and improve energy efficiency in data centers, challenging the assumption that semiconductor advantage equals Nvidia's ecosystem and process technology.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this chip-advantage signal; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: OpenAI自研推理芯片Jalapeño基准首公开：每瓦吞吐较Nvidia高1.5-1.9倍
zh.coreFact: OpenAI发布700W TDP自研推理芯片基准：相对Nvidia GB200/GB300系统，峰值吞吐下每瓦AI工作量高1.5-1.9倍，端到端延迟低1.7-3.6倍；OpenAI表示“我们造了一颗芯片，而且它很快”。
zh.whyItMatters: 若规模化部署，自研芯片首次拿出优于Nvidia的可比证据，将改写推理算力需求结构，并直接改善数据中心能效，对“半导体优势=生态+制程”的默认判断构成修正压力。

en.title: Taiwan indicts nine, including an Nvidia employee, for smuggling B300 servers to China
en.coreFact: Keelung prosecutors indicted nine people including a Taiwan-based Nvidia employee; 130 high-end AI servers with B300 chips were allegedly exported through Japan and Indonesia to evade US controls; 74 reached China and 56 were seized; a Super Micro employee and Taiwanese distributors were named; prosecutors seek up to 5 years for four people; B300 chips built at TSMC Phoenix are then packaged in Taiwan.
en.whyItMatters: US export-control enforcement has moved down to individuals, logistics and packaging, operated by Taiwan's judiciary. The Taiwan packaging step is a physical chokepoint in the allied AI supply chain, now shown to be vulnerable to insider smuggling.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this enforcement-and-supply-chain signal; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 台湾起诉英伟达员工等9人涉嫌走私B300服务器至中国
zh.coreFact: 基隆地检署起诉英伟达台湾员工等9人，涉130台B300高端AI服务器黑市出口：74台已运抵中国、56台被台海关截获；经日本、印尼中转规避美国出口管制；涉及超微电脑员工及台湾分销商；检方对4人求处最高5年刑期。B300由台积电凤凰城厂生产后送回台湾封装。
zh.whyItMatters: 美国出口管制执法首次下沉到个人、物流与封装环节，并由台湾司法执行；台湾封装环节成为盟友AI供应链的物理咽喉，也显示出该环节的执法脆弱性。

en.title: Texas ERCOT audit finds ~474GW of interconnection requests, 90% from data centers
en.coreFact: Governor Abbott ordered a suspension of data center interconnection progress; PUCT and ERCOT are auditing the queue of ~250-300 projects; ERCOT disclosed it is considering ~474GW of interconnection requests, ~90% of which are data centers; large-load reports were deferred. Similar EU moves: Spain's draft requires 80% renewable hourly matching for data centers; Finland raised the data center electricity tax ~44x; Germany mandates PUE 1.2 and waste-heat reuse.
en.whyItMatters: Grid interconnection approval is becoming the physical ceiling on compute expansion. Texas's administrative pause may push capital to other states and strengthen the model of co-locating generation with compute, as in the Nscale deal.
en.processMatchReason: No existing process in the dossier fits this energy-governance signal; suggestedProcessId is null.

zh.title: 得州ERCOT审计：互联队列约474GW，90%为数据中心
zh.coreFact: 得州州长Abbott暂停数据中心互联推进，PUCT与ERCOT对约250-300个项目进行核查审计；ERCOT披露正在考虑约474GW互联申请，其中90%为数据中心；大负荷报告延期。同向信号：西班牙草案要求数据中心每小时80%可再生电力实时匹配，芬兰将数据中心电税提高约44倍，德国强制PUE 1.2与余热利用。
zh.whyItMatters: 互联审批成为算力扩张的物理上限。美国最大数据中心市场的政策暂停将迫使资本向其他地区再配置，并提高“发电资产+算力绑定”模式的吸引力；能源治理正在决定算力地理。
